svg.title: All creatures, by order and family

g.text: Strands · thin strings of beads or links
Barbed spines · columns of barbed segments
Ringbacks · columns of ringed segments, with legs, claws or horns
Winged worms · one pair of wings at the head of a long tail
Twin-finned · wings at the head and fins again at the tail
Drapes · draped wings on a short dense body
Split wings · two wings and almost no body
Swifts · one or two pairs of sickle blades on a slim body
Seraphs · many wings and blades layered around an ornate body
Wardens · an eye set in a horned plate
Wheels · a ring with spikes, rays or limbs radiating from it
Bells · a hood over many trailing tendrils
Twin-tails · a body ending in two long tails
